ios.desc:
VoxPlan - Add Calendar Events with Your Voice

VoxPlan turns natural speech into calendar events in seconds. Say what you need, confirm once, and you're done.

"Team meeting tomorrow at 9am"
"Lunch with Sarah Friday at 1"

No forms. No scrolling. No friction.

CREATE EVENTS IN SECONDS

Tap, speak, and confirm - done in under 5 seconds
AI understands natural language instantly
Automatically fills title, date, time, duration, and location
Smart preview before saving so you stay in control
Optional Auto mode for instant, no-confirm adds

BUILT FOR SPEED AND CLARITY

Clean, minimal design focused on getting things done
Day, Week, and Month views
Switch views with a single tap
Quickly edit or create events manually when needed

WORKS WITH YOUR CALENDAR

Syncs with your iOS calendars
Manage all events in one place
Home Screen widget for today's schedule at a glance
Works with Siri, Shortcuts and the Action button

GLOBAL AND FLEXIBLE

App available in 15 languages
Speak in any of 30 languages
Works with natural phrases, accents, and variations
Set reminders with flexible alert timing
Customize your week start and calendar layout

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your voice is processed securely and never stored. Audio is transcribed and immediately discarded.

No tracking. No data selling. No Ads. Ever.

Powered by European AI (Mistral). Fully GDPR-compliant.

Save time every day. Download VoxPlan and start planning with your voice.

Privacy Policy: https://suvirbhargav.github.io/voxplan.github.io/privacy-policy.html
